items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like Bach and Chopin. Chopin is so hard to play

ctx.x: Which one of the masters do you prefer, like Chopin, Beethoven, Bach, Brahms…
I like Bach and Chopin. Chopin is so hard to play, oh my god, you have to play it real soft and light and fleeting.
